title: Ordinary slice restriction and model normalization
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an object of its pro-etale site, R a commutative-ring sheaf on that site [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], B a commutative-ring sheaf on its model site, and T a commutative-ring sheaf on the slice of the model site over up(U). Let e identify the transport of R with B, and let c from the slice restriction of B to T be invertible. There exists an additive functor G from modules over R restricted to U to modules over T, preserving finite limits and finite colimits. Model transport and scalar restriction along inverse e, followed by the slice pull functor along c [lem-sfb-adic-stratum-completion-unit], is naturally isomorphic to ordinary restriction to U followed by G [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars].

source.place: Section localize, label definition-localize-ringed-site; Tags 03D2 and 03D3, scalar extension/restriction adjunction; Sites label lemma-localize-compare, applied to AsSmall.

proof.text: Use Over.postEquiv for AsSmall to identify the model slice with the original slice. Both directions are cocontinuous, so the equivalence is continuous. Compose inverse c with the slice restriction of inverse e. This is the coefficient map for module pushforward from the original slice to the model slice.

Define G to be that continuous module pushforward. It is additive on sections. Finite limits commute with the underlying precomposition, and cocontinuity gives preservation of abelian-sheaf colimits; the module forgetful comparison reflects them. Thus G is exact. Extension along c is restriction along inverse c by the tensor/restriction adjunction and the scalar equivalence. The remaining comparison is identity on sections and restriction maps, hence natural.

theorem sfbOrdinarySliceNormalization
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (U : S.ProEt)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology S) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (B : Sheaf (proEtaleModelTopology S) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (T : Sheaf ((proEtaleModelTopology S).over (AsSmall.up.obj U))
      CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (e : (sfbModelRings S).obj R ≅ B)
    (c : ((SfbAdicRestriction.sliceAlgebra (proEtaleModelTopology S)
      (AsSmall.up.obj U)).rings.obj B) ⟶ T) [IsIso c] :
    ∃ G : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} (((adicLisseForget S).obj R).over U) ⥤
        ConstantCompletion.Mod T,
      G.Additive ∧ PreservesFiniteLimits G ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits G ∧
      Nonempty
        ((proEtaleModuleToModel ((adicLisseForget S).obj R) ⋙
            ConstantCompletion.res e.inv) ⋙
            ConstantCompletion.pull
              (SfbAdicRestriction.sliceAlgebra (proEtaleModelTopology S)
                (AsSmall.up.obj U)) c ≅
          SheafOfModules.overFunctor ((adicLisseForget S).obj R) U ⋙ G)
